lines.en: label amisroom15:
scene lr_day
I decide to spend the morning with Ami, and not just because I don’t feel like going anywhere else this time.
lines.zh: 我决定这个上午陪 Ami,而且不只是因为这回我懒得去别处。

lines.en: I admit that this seemingly small factor may sometimes play a large role in determining whether I spend time with her or not, but it’s not like I don’t want to see her or anything like that.
lines.zh: 我承认,这个看似微不足道的因素,有时确实会在我「陪不陪她」的决定里扮演重要角色;但这不代表我不想见她什么的。

lines.en: Ami and I have gotten close enough that I have basically accepted her as family at this point.
lines.zh: Ami 和我已经亲近到——事到如今,我基本已经把她当成了家人。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
Just...family with the added bonus of providing sexual favors for one another every now and then.
lines.zh: 只是……一个偶尔会互相提供性服务的加料版家人。

lines.en: But whatever. Sue us. It's not like no family has ever done this sort of stuff together before.
lines.zh: 但无所谓。告我们啊。又不是没有别的家人一起干过这种事。

lines.en: else:
The only thing is...it’s kind of hard to avoid that she might be feeling a little more than that.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是……很难回避她可能感觉到的,比那更多一点。

lines.en: It’s weird...When I first woke up here, I had every intention of just using any chance I had to get physically closer with her.
lines.zh: 很怪……我刚在这里醒来时,满脑子都是利用一切机会、和她发生身体接触。

lines.en: But now look at me.
lines.zh: 可现在再看看我。

lines.en: I’m about to walk into her room and I don’t even almost have an erection.
lines.zh: 我正要走进她的房间,而我居然连一丝勃起的迹象都没有。

lines.en: In fact, if I didn’t spend half of every day perving out on other [teenage]girls, I might even consider myself starting to change.
lines.zh: 事实上,要不是每天有一半时间我对其他 [teenage] 女孩咸猪手,我几乎要以为自己开始改变了。

lines.en: scene black
I make my way over to Ami’s door and, as is becoming customary, decide to push it open without knocking like the true gentleman I am.
lines.zh: 我走到 Ami 的门前,并且——这渐渐成了惯例——决定像个真正的绅士那样,不敲门直接推门进去。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive1
: Hmmm hmmm hmmm~
lines.zh: : 嗯 嗯 嗯~

lines.en: : Hmmmmm hmm hmmmmm hmmm~
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯 嗯 嗯嗯嗯 嗯~

lines.en: Ami happily hums a song to herself while sorting through her manga collection.
lines.zh: Ami 一边开心地哼着歌,一边整理她的漫画收藏。

lines.en: I’m surprised to see that she’s already dressed for the day when weekend-Ami has become all but synonymous with lounging around the house in her pajamas and waiting for me to talk to her.
lines.zh: 我很意外她已经穿戴整齐——毕竟「周末的 Ami」几乎就等于穿着睡衣窝在家里、等我搭话的同义词。

lines.en: : Morning. What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 早。在干嘛?

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive2
: Ah?!
: What the heck, [amimaster]? Why are you just sneaking up on me like that?!
lines.zh: : 搞什么,[amimaster]?你怎么像鬼一样悄无声息地贴过来?!

lines.en: : Even if I never get mad at you for not doing it, you should still remember to knock, you know?
lines.zh: : 就算我不因为你不出声而生气,你也应该记得敲门,你知道吗?

lines.en: : I don’t remember how to knock.
lines.zh: : 我不记得怎么敲门了。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive3
: You...don't remember how?...
lines.zh: : 你……不记得「怎么」敲?……

lines.en: : Yeah. I don't think my hands work that way. You'll just have to deal with this from now on. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 对。我觉得我的手已经不具备那种机能了。以后你就将就吧。抱歉。

lines.en: : Can you at least try to remember when it comes to knocking on other girls' doors? Because I don't want you walking in on them when they're vulnerable.
lines.zh: : 那你至少对其他女孩的门,试着记得敲行吗?我可不想你趁她们脆弱的时候撞进去。

lines.en: : But with you, it's fine?
lines.zh: : 但对你就可以?

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive4
: Mhm. With me it's fine. But I really wish you'd at least warn me before coming in so I don't have a heart attack next time I turn around and see you there.
lines.zh: : 嗯。对我就行。不过我真希望你进来之前至少提醒我一声,免得我下次一转身看到你,又心脏病发作。

lines.en: : So, does you being here mean that...you maybe want to hang out with me? Cause I was just going to spend the morning reading, but-
lines.zh: : 那么,你来这里的意思是……你也许想陪我玩?因为我本来打算花一上午看书,但是——

lines.en: : What were you going to read?
lines.zh: : 你打算看什么?

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive5
: Uhh...nothing you’d be interested in.
lines.zh: : 呃……你不会感兴趣的东西。

lines.en: : Try me.
lines.zh: : 说来听听。

lines.en: : Okay, well...the series I’ve been reading is about this one girl with magical powers and-
lines.zh: : 好吧……我在追的这部,讲的是一个拥有魔法力量的女孩,和——

lines.en: : Yup. Not interested.
lines.zh: : 嗯。没兴趣。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive6
: I'm honestly a little surprised you even made it that far.
lines.zh: : 说实话,你能听到这一步我都挺意外的。

lines.en: : I’m just kidding. You can keep going with your description.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。你继续介绍。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive5
: Okay...So, she’s got magical powers and she needs to save the world from all these villains that keep showing up.
lines.zh: : 好……那么,她拥有魔法力量,要拯救世界,还得对付不断冒出来的反派。

lines.en: : But the thing is, the biggest villain of them all is actually her childhood friend and love interest.
lines.zh: : 但关键在于,反派里最大的那个,其实是她的青梅竹马兼恋爱对象。

lines.en: : Wow. Do you immediately spoil major details like that for everyone who asks you about something you're reading? Or am I just the lucky one?
lines.zh: : 哇。任何一个问你「你在读什么」的人,你都这样直接剧透重大细节吗?还是说只有我有这份幸运?

lines.en: : Is it really even a spoiler if I know for a fact that you're never going to read it?
lines.zh: : 反正我确定你永远不会去读,那还算剧透吗?

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive7
: Besides, you really don’t need to ask me about stuff I know you’re not interested in, [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 再说了,[amimaster],明知道你不感兴趣的东西,你就真的不用来问我。

lines.en: : The fact that you’re willing to pretend to be interested is enough for me.
lines.zh: : 你愿意假装感兴趣,对我就已经足够了。

lines.en: : Pretending? Who’s pretending? For all you know, I could be a huge otaku who just keeps his hobbies a secret from everyone else.
lines.zh: : 假装?谁假装了?说不定我是个隐藏极深的宅,只是从不告诉任何人我的爱好。

lines.en: : Lies. You can't earn the title of otaku unless you annoy other people about your hobbies and try to force them into liking the things you like.
lines.zh: : 骗人。你不烦着别人安利你的爱好、不强行安利别人入坑,就挣不到「宅」这个头衔。

lines.en: : I feel like that's not true. But anyway, did you want to do something today?
lines.zh: : 我觉得这话不对。总之,你今天想干点什么?

lines.en: : It’s been a little while since the two of us just spent the whole day hanging around the house, so I figured we could do that if you don't have any better ideas?
lines.zh: : 我们俩好久没有整天宅在家里了,所以要是你没有更好的主意,我们不如就这样过?

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive8
: Wait, the whole day day? You mean like...morning, afternoon, and night?
lines.zh: : 等等,一整天?你是说……早上、下午、加晚上?

lines.en: : Yes, Ami. Those are the three key parts of the day.
lines.zh: : 是,Ami。那正是一天的三大组成部分。

lines.en: : So...I get to spend the entire day with you?
lines.zh: : 那么……我可以和你待一整天了?

lines.en: : You do.
lines.zh: : 可以。

lines.en: : And you’re not gonna go anywhere else?
lines.zh: : 而且你哪儿也不去?

lines.en: : I’m not.
lines.zh: : 哪儿也不去。

lines.en: : And you’re going to hold my hand the whole time?
lines.zh: : 而且你会全程牵着我的手?

lines.en: : Do you really think I'd fall for that?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我会上那个当?

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive9
: Heheh...I thought I might be able to fit that in there without you noticing.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……我本以为能把它夹带进去、不被你发现呢。

lines.en: : Holding hands for an entire day sounds a little too cute for my liking. I'm not sure if my mind or body would even allow it.
lines.zh: : 牵一整天的手,对我而言可爱得有点过了。我不确定我的心智或身体会不会批准。

lines.en: : Are hugs too cute for your liking as well? Because I haven't gotten one of those yet and I'm starting to think you woke up anti-Ami today.
lines.zh: : 那拥抱也可爱得过了吗?因为我还没抱到呢,而且我开始觉得你今天早上起来是「反 Ami 形态」。

lines.en: : I have literally been in here for five minutes and, within that time, already devoted my entire day to you. What more do you want?
lines.zh: : 我进来才五分钟,而在这五分钟里,我已经把今天一整天都奉献给你了。你还想要什么?

lines.en: : An amount of hugs that is...bigger than zero?
lines.zh: : 一个……大于零的拥抱?

lines.en: : Pass.
lines.zh: : 驳回。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive10
: What’s even the point of spending the whole day together if I'm not allowed to hug you?! What else do you wanna do, Sensei?! Talk about the economy?!
lines.zh: : 不许拥抱的话,我们一起待一天还有什么意义?!那你还想干什么,Sensei?!聊经济?!

lines.en: : What? No. Why would you even assume that?
lines.zh: : 什么?不。你为什么会往那方面想?

lines.en: : Because it's the most boring thing I can think of and you are clearly only here to play with my feelings by not hugging me!
lines.zh: : 因为那是我想得到的最无聊的事,而你明明只是为了玩弄我的感情才不抱我的!

lines.en: : How about we just watch TV or something? That’s a thing we can both enjoy, right?
lines.zh: : 不如我们看会儿电视什么的?那是我们俩都能享受的事,对吧?

lines.en: : And hey, if you let me choose what we watch, I think I can be kind enough to let you hug my arm for a few minutes at a time so long as you don't squeeze too tightly.
lines.zh: : 而且你要是让我选片,我大概可以大发慈悲,允许你抱着我的胳膊几分钟一轮——只要你别勒太紧。

lines.en: : I don’t need permission to hug my [uncle]’s arm!
lines.zh: : 抱 [uncle] 的胳膊还用你批准!

lines.en: scene black
: Hey! Where are you going?! You can't just leave like that without saying anything!
lines.zh: : 喂!你去哪?!你不能什么话都不说就这样走掉!

lines.en: : I'm going to the living room before I wind up being assaulted by a five-foot redhead.
lines.zh: : 我去客厅,免得被一个五英尺高的红毛少女袭击。

lines.en: : I’m five-foot-two! This is a thing you should know!
lines.zh: : 我五英尺二!这是你必须记住的事!

lines.en: : Pay more attention to me!
lines.zh: : 多关注我一点!

lines.en: I exit Ami’s room and take a seat on the couch, waiting for her to join me.
lines.zh: 我走出 Ami 的房间,在沙发上坐下,等她过来。

lines.en: I obviously have no problem hugging her or holding her hand or any of the other annoyingly adorable things she’s somehow able to say without blushing in the comfort of our home-
lines.zh: : 我当然不介意抱她、牵她的手,或者任何她能在这间屋子里脸不红心不跳说出口的、可爱得让人烦躁的事——

lines.en: It’s just really fun to tease her.
lines.zh: : 只是她实在太好玩了。

lines.en: And I intend to continue doing that for the rest of our time together.
lines.zh: : 而且我打算,在我们相处的余生里,把逗她这件事进行到底。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive11
: You don’t love me anymore.
lines.zh: : 你不爱我了。

lines.en: : You got me. All of the love inside of me has faded into nothingness.
lines.zh: : 被你抓到了。我体内全部的爱,已化为虚无。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I just won’t cook you dinner anymore.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我不给你做晚饭了。

lines.en: : Nevermind. I love you again. Please don't stop cooking for me. I will die.
lines.zh: : 收回前言。我又爱你了。请别停止给我做饭。我会死的。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive12
: Yay! You told me you loved me and I didn't even have to ask!
lines.zh: : 耶!你主动说了你爱我,我都没开口要!

lines.en: : Yup. That is definitely what happened.
lines.zh: : 对。事情确实是这样发生的。

lines.en: : This means you'll keep making me dinner, right?
lines.zh: : 也就是说你会继续给我做晚饭,对吧?

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive13
: Heheh...we’ll see. Dinner’s not until much later in the day, so you’re going to have to be extra nice to me if you want to eat.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……看情况。晚饭还早着呢,所以想吃的话,你今天得对我格外好。

lines.en: : I’m a prisoner in my own home.
lines.zh: : 我成了自己家的人质。

lines.en: : That’s right. And I, Ami Arakawa, am the true protagonist of this story.
lines.zh: : 没错。而我,Ami Arakawa,才是这个故事真正的主角。

lines.en: : Does that mean I’m your childhood friend-slash-villain of the story like in that manga you were talking about earlier?
lines.zh: : 那我是不是你那个故事里的青梅竹马兼反派?就像你刚才聊的那部漫画一样?

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive14
: I wish...It would be so much easier if the two of us were childhood friends.
lines.zh: : 我倒希望……要是我们是青梅竹马,事情会简单太多。

lines.en: : Why did you have to go and be born like a million years earlier than me? And also be related to my dad?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要早生一百万年?还偏偏是我爸的亲戚?

lines.en: : You’re just putting roadblocks all over this relationship, [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 你只是在这段关系里到处设路障,[amimaster]。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: I don’t know. I kind of like you the way you are.
lines.zh: : 说不清。我有点喜欢你现在的样子。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive15
: Huh?
: Yeah. I don’t know if the two of us ever would have gotten close if it wasn’t for our relationship.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我甚至不确定,如果没有这层关系,我们俩会不会走得这么近。

lines.en: : Can you...tell me you like me the way I am again, please?
lines.zh: : 你能……再告诉我一遍你喜欢我现在的样子吗,求你了?

lines.en: : No. That was your one compliment for the morning. You’ll get another in the afternoon. Please look forward to it.
lines.zh: : 不行。那是你今早唯一一次夸奖。下午还有一次。敬请期待。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive16
: Guess I’ll take what I can get, then...
lines.zh: : 那我只好能捞多少捞多少了……

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive17
: Besides, I...also like the way things are now. And even though you’re a big dummy jerk-pants who won’t hold my hand, I know I can rely on you.
lines.zh: : 对了,我……也喜欢现在的样子。虽然你是个不肯牵我手的大笨蛋混蛋裤,但我知道我可以依赖你。

lines.en: : I’d still probably feel safe with you if we were the same age but...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 哪怕我们同龄,我在你身边大概也会安心,只是……不知道。

lines.en: : I’m probably gonna start ranting about weird stuff if you don’t stop me.
lines.zh: : 你要不拦着我,我大概要开始念叨一些奇怪的东西了。

lines.en: I wait for a moment to see if Ami continues.
lines.zh: : 我等了片刻,看 Ami 会不会继续。

lines.en: : Sensei, this is the point where you’re supposed to stop me.
lines.zh: : Sensei,这种时候你应该叫停我的。

lines.en: Damn it.
lines.zh: : 该死。

lines.en: : Fine. Stop.
lines.zh: : 行。停。

lines.en: else:
: What am I putting roadblocks over exactly? We’re just [uncle] and [niece]. The way things are now is fine.
lines.zh: : 我到底在哪些地方「设路障」了?我们就是 [uncle] 和 [niece]。现在这样挺好的。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive17
: Uhh...yeah. I know. I was just...making a joke or something.
lines.zh: : 呃……对。我知道。我只是……开个玩笑什么的。

lines.en: : Of course I know that...all we are is [uncle] and [niece]...
lines.zh: : 我当然知道……我们只是 [uncle] 和 [niece]……

lines.en: : And that's...probably all we'll ever be.
lines.zh: : 而……大概我们永远也只会是这样。

lines.en: Ami reaches out and grabs the remote for the TV, switching it on and turning it to some early-morning kids anime.
lines.zh: Ami 伸手抓起电视遥控器,打开电视,调到某个清晨档的儿童动画。

lines.en: : I'm fine with you putting on whatever, but I didn't think you'd just waive your right to hugging my arm in short bursts throughout the rest of the morning so easily.
lines.zh: : 我不介意你随便放点什么,但我真没想到,你会这么干脆地放弃「今早剩余时间分批次抱我胳膊」的权利。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive18
: You say that like you have any influence over when and where I hug you.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像我什么时候抱你、在哪抱你,得由你批准似的。

lines.en: : Also, why would I give up control of the remote when you’d just put on something lame like the news?
lines.zh: : 再说了,遥控器凭什么交给你——你只会放新闻那种无聊玩意。

lines.en: : When have I literally ever put on the news before?
lines.zh: : 我哪一次放过新闻?

lines.en: : You used to put the news on all the time to try and get me to go to sleep when I was younger.
lines.zh: : 我小的时候,你老放新闻,想哄我睡觉。

lines.en: : Did it work?
lines.zh: : 有用吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, cause the news is boring.
lines.zh: : 有,因为新闻很无聊。

lines.en: : Cool. Then let's put the news on. You've had a long day and deserve the rest.
lines.zh: : 那好。我们放新闻吧。你熬了漫长的一天,值得好好休息。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive18r
: I've been awake for half an hour!
lines.zh: : 我才醒了半个小时!

lines.en: : Wow, it's been that long already?
lines.zh: : 哇,已经半个小时了?

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive19
: That's it! I'm hugging you now and you can't do anything about it!
lines.zh: : 够了!我现在就抱你,你拦不住!

lines.en: Ami lunges at me and latches onto my arm, digging her fingers into my skin and squeezing me so hard that there's honestly a chance I could bruise from it.
lines.zh: Ami 扑过来,挂上我的手臂,手指抠进我的皮肤,勒得那么紧——说真的,我都有可能淤青。

lines.en: : I guess I kind of asked for this by teasing you, didn't I?
lines.zh: : 我猜这是我逗你的报应,对吧?

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive20
: That's right. The meaner you are, the nicer I have to be to make up for it. Sorry not sorry.
lines.zh: : 没错。你越坏,我就得越好,好把你的坏补回来。抱歉,但不抱歉。

lines.en: : What exactly is “Sorry not sorry?”
lines.zh: : 「抱歉,但不抱歉」到底是什么玩意?

lines.en: : A thing that you would know if you weren't a dinosaur.
lines.zh: : 一个你不是恐龙就会懂的玩意。

lines.en: : Me being a dinosaur implies that you're part-dinosaur, doesn't it?
lines.zh: : 我是恐龙,等于你有一半恐龙血统,不是吗?

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. I didn’t get the dino gene. I’m a purebred cute girl who must be protected.
lines.zh: : 才不是。我没领到恐龙基因。我是必须被保护的纯种可爱女孩。

lines.en: : Protected from what? We’re the only two people in the house.
lines.zh: : 被谁保护?这屋里只有我们两个人。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive21
: You don’t know that.
lines.zh: : 这可说不准。

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive22
: Just kidding! Hahahahaha...
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的!哈哈哈哈哈……

lines.en: scene amisroomonefive23
: Oh! [amimaster]! I’ve actually seen this episode before!
lines.zh: : 哦![amimaster]!这一集我看过了!

lines.en: : This is the part where two childhood friends have to fight each other to prove who’s strongest!
lines.zh: : 这里是两个青梅竹马必须打一架、证明谁更强的桥段!

lines.en: : What is it with anime and this childhood friend trope? How often do people even keep friends from their childhood around?
lines.zh: : 动画为什么这么迷恋青梅竹马梗?现实中真有多少人从小到大的朋友还留着?

lines.en: : Shhh, don’t ask questions about anime! Just accept it! Now watch.
lines.zh: : 嘘,不许问动画的问题!接受设定就行!看。
